source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 februarie — «Sfântul Cuvios Talasie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιοι Θαλάσσιος και Λιμναίος»

attestations.note: One page for the two of them, which rests them on Theodoret of Cyrrhus and the Synaxarion of Constantinople. It gives no year for either and prints no hymn. Thalassius's hermitage is put on a small mountain of a village of Cyrrhus called Tillimas.
